name: in-to-out-text-message
description: MessageProcessor flow on its own (Output flow off): a text message put on WMQ 'in' by any producer is consumed in a transaction, held for 15 s, and put on WMQ 'out' as a TextMessage with ' - processed' appended. 'in' is empty afterwards.

source.reference: websphere-mq/src/main/app/websphere-mq.xml (wmq:inbound-endpoint queue='in' ALWAYS_BEGIN; test:component appendString=' - processed' waitTime=15000; wmq:outbound-endpoint queue='out' JOIN_IF_POSSIBLE)
